title: Pál Bornemisza to Ferdinand I on the Kendi treason, Transylvania c. 1556 (DECODE R1212)

documents.shelfmark: ÖStA HHStA Staatskanzlei Interiora, Chiffrenschlüssel Kt. 13, Fasc. 20, ff. 38-39 (DECODE R1212)

plaintext.source: Contemporary interlinear decipherment over nearly every cipher run; no printed edition found.

transcription.source: DECODE images IMG_R1212_I6001-I6004 via saved session cookie
transcription.notes: Read in bands at half then full resolution by subagents; each run deciphered from the signs with key R1211 and compared with the gloss. Token counts hand-tallied from reading_p1-2.md and reading_p3-4.md (274 cipher words + 14 codes).

system.summary: Monoalphabetic homophonic cipher in graphic signs and digits (1-3 signs per letter), word division kept, with a tiny numeric nomenclator (34 Transsylvania, 27 Petrovics) and further unkeyed number codes.
system.notes: Writer loose with the key: x/v also u, ~ also u/o, 9 (c) for t, barred Π for h, ϐ for c/h. Digit pairs inside runs are letters (34 = al).

prior_solution.where: Contemporary interlinear decipherment on the letter itself; key R1211 on DECODE.

conditions.human_role: Project-level: DECODE login cookie and /goal target setting. No target-specific intervention.
tools: PIL (cropping and zooming the page images)

solution.what: Fetched R1212 metadata and four images from DECODE with the saved cookie.
Viewed the pages: interlinear Latin gloss over nearly every cipher run; docket names Paulo Bornemisza; p.4 foot sign rows with pencil letters.
Spot-checked glosses against signs (horum omnium, nullus, fidia, tumultus): consistent homophonic letter substitution.

Listed DECODE records of Kt. 13 Fasc. 20 ff. 34-45; fetched R1209-R1215. R1211 (f. 37) is the graphic-sign key with codes 34 Transsylvania, 27 Petrovics; R1210 (f. 36) an older numeric Bornemisza key of c. 1540.
Web search for a printed edition (Bornemisza, Kendi, cipher, 1556).
First-pass transcription of pp. 1-2 and 3-4 by two subagents, glosses checked against key R1211.

Full-resolution second passes: every run deciphered from the signs, compared with the gloss; a dozen gloss corrections, unglossed runs read, apparent codes 0399/134/34 shown to be letters; sender identified as Bornemisza from first-person passages.
Tried R1210's name codes on the unkeyed numbers 24, 15, 10, 41, 70, 55, 78, 18, 52: no sense.

outcome.method_basis: The key is DECODE R1211, the leaf before the letter in the same fascicle (HHStA Kt. 13 Fasc. 20 f. 37); every run was deciphered from the signs with it and compared with the contemporary interlinear gloss, which covers nearly every run.
outcome.notes: Whole letter read; the contemporary gloss verified and corrected sign by sign with key R1211. Open: 9 unkeyed number codes and 3 illegible signs.
outcome.fraction_read_source: reading_p1-2.md + reading_p3-4.md: cipher words 274 (257 secure + 14 uncertain in sense read, 3 unread) + codes 14 (5 keyed, 9 not): 276/288 = 0.958 (hand tally by the reading passes).

gaps.detail: not on key R1211; R1210 codes are another cipher; unread at the time too

gaps.item: two signs p.1 l.9; run R Ɔ C p.3 l.5
gaps.detail: covered by a struck gloss / sign not in key
